name: PheedLoop
description_en:
PheedLoop is a modular event-management platform connecting registration, event sites, exhibitors, speakers, attendee apps, onsite operations and reporting. It also offers continuing-education tracking and certification workflows, where attendance evidence must support the organizer’s rules. The catalogue of capabilities does not mean every module is part of the base price.

Its public offer separates the annual core, attendee-priced modules and physical check-in equipment. An event team should budget software, participants, kiosks, badges, consumables and support as a complete delivery configuration rather than compare only the core starting amount.
description_zh:
PheedLoop 是模块化活动平台，关联报名、网站、展商、讲者、应用、现场及报表，另有继续教育跟踪与认证，出席证据需满足主办方规则。能力目录不代表基础价格包含全部模块。

公开方案把年核心平台、按参与者计模块和实体签到设备区分。团队应整体预算软件、人数、终端、徽章、耗材和支持，而不只比较核心起价。

core_features.explanation_en: Give exhibitors and speakers task and content workflows.
core_features.explanation_zh: 为展商和讲者提供任务及内容流程。

core_features.explanation_en: Connect check-in, badge printing and education-credit evidence under selected modules.
core_features.explanation_zh: 按所选模块关联签到、徽章及教育学分证据。

en: Coordinate attendee registration, exhibitor tasks and onsite attendance evidence.
zh: 协调人员报名、展商任务及现场出席证据。
use_cases.basis: Editorial task suggestions based on official documentation; no observed deployment.

steps.en: List required modules and all stakeholder counts, then test registration, check-in, export and the intended CE rule.
steps.zh: 列出模块与全部相关方人数，再测试报名、签到、导出及所需学分规则。

items.en: Selection judgments and examples are documentation-based; no live workflow was tested.
items.zh: 选型判断与例子依据文档，未实测真实流程。

pricing.billing_basis: Annual core plus attendee-priced modules, equipment and consumables/services.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Core from $950/year; selected modules from $1/attendee. Onsite bundle from $600 for two kiosks and a printer; badges from $1.50 and lanyards from $1. Exact price by modules, attendee volume and event type; currency, taxes, shipping, support and metering require quote confirmation.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 核心起年 $950，所选模块起每人 $1；现场两终端加打印机组合起 $600，徽章起 $1.50、挂绳起 $1。准确价格按模块、人数和类型，币种、税、运输、支持及计量需报价确认。

sources.title: Event Management Software for In-Person, Virtual & Hybrid Events | PheedLoop
sources.research_notes_en: Modular event system including registration, exhibitor/speaker workflows, apps, onsite and CE tracking; marketing outcomes not independently verified.

sources.title: PheedLoop Pricing — Get a Custom Quote
sources.research_notes_en: Core from $950/year, modules from $1/attendee, onsite bundle from $600 with two kiosks+printer, badges/lanyards separate and exact quote by modules/count/type.

official_check.scope: Public official documents read; no purchase, account setup, independent review, hands-on test, identity verification or publication approval.

review_notes: Official documentation describes vendor functionality, not independent evidence of reliability, adoption or outcomes.
Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese draft; examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance.
Current public pricing is a dated snapshot; purchase conditions remain subject to vendor confirmation.

sections.title_en: Follow one attendee and one exhibitor through the event
sections.title_zh: 沿参与者与展商分别核对流程
sections.en: For an illustrative trade conference, configure ticket tiers, attendee questions and an exhibitor task list. Link the accepted speaker content and session agenda, then test onsite check-in and the resulting report. Attendee registration, exhibitor lead capture and education-credit qualification are distinct records and permissions. A scan alone does not prove all credit requirements were met or permit every exhibitor to export the guest’s data.
sections.zh: 例如行业会议，应配置票种、人员问题及展商任务，连接讲者内容和议程，再测试现场签到及报表。人员报名、展商线索和学分资格是不同记录与权限。一次扫描不能证明符合全部学分要求，也不授权所有展商导出该人的数据。

sections.title_en: Read the attendee module price beside the annual core
sections.title_zh: 把人数模块费与年核心费一起看
sections.en: The pricing form advertises core software from $950/year and additional modules from $1 per attendee. It describes unlimited events with pay-as-you-go module use; exact charges depend on modules, participant count and event type. These are starting figures, not a complete event quote. Confirm whether speakers, exhibitors, sponsors and imported records count, since the enquiry form asks for the total across stakeholder types.
sections.zh: 价格表单列核心起每年 $950，附加模块起每位 $1，说明不限活动并按模块使用付费，实际取决于模块、人数及类型。这是起价，不是整场报价。询价表要求包括讲者、展商、赞助商等总人数，因此需确认这些角色及导入记录如何计量。

sections.title_zh: 把实体签到费用算进去
sections.en: Onsite check-in/badging starts at $600 per bundle of two kiosks and a printer. Badges start $1.50 each and lanyards $1 each. For a hypothetical 300-badge/300-lanyard event, those starting consumables alone total $750, before equipment, shipping, taxes or support. This arithmetic is not a quote. Verify printer stock, connectivity, offline merge and who handles a failure at the entrance.
sections.zh: 现场签到/徽章组合起 $600，含两终端和一打印机；徽章起每个 $1.50，挂绳起 $1。假设 300 徽章和 300 挂绳，仅按起价的耗材即 $750，尚未含设备、运输、税或支持。这只是算例。需确认打印耗材、网络、离线合并及入口失败由谁处理。

sections.title_en: Validate the chosen modules and exception ownership
sections.title_zh: 核对所选模块与异常负责人
sections.en: PheedLoop merits investigation for teams needing several connected event roles and onsite delivery. A small ticket-only event may need less configuration. Trial a changed registration, missing session scan, exhibitor export and final data exit under the quoted plan. No module, hardware, CE rule, payment, API or recovery was tested. Currency, contractual storage/retention, source license and self-hosted distribution remain unverified.
sections.zh: 多个活动角色及现场交付需要关联时，可研究 PheedLoop，小型纯售票可能无需如此配置。应按报价方案试验报名修改、漏扫、展商导出和最终数据退出。本文未测试模块、硬件、学分规则、支付、API 或恢复，币种、合同存储/保留、源码许可和自托管发行版仍未核实。

research_gaps: No registration, portal, app, printer, CE rule, payment, API, offline merge or export was tested.
Currency, attendee/module metering, shipping/support/processor costs, data terms, source license and self-hosting remain unverified.

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.
